module Knowledge
  class EmbeddingJob
    def call(document_id:, tenant_id:, version:, provider:)
      snapshot = Document.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
      return :discarded unless snapshot

      vector = provider.call(snapshot.body)
      Document.transaction do
        current = Document.lock.find_by(id: document_id, tenant_id: tenant_id, published: true)
        return :discarded unless current && current.revision == snapshot.revision

        Embedding.upsert({ document_id: current.id, tenant_id: tenant_id, revision: current.revision,
                           version: version, vector: JSON.generate(vector) }, unique_by: %i[document_id version])
      end
      :stored
    end
  end
end

module Knowledge
  class PublishDelivery
    def call(delivery_id:, store:)
      delivery = Delivery.find(delivery_id)
      payload = JSON.parse(delivery.payload)
      begin
        store.publish(id: delivery.event_id, type: 'DocumentPublished', data: payload)
      rescue store.duplicate_error
        existing = store.read(delivery.event_id)
        raise 'conflicting event' unless existing == { type: 'DocumentPublished', data: payload }
      end
      delivery.update!(delivered: true)
      :delivered
    end
  end
end

module Knowledge
  class RebuildSearch
    def call(index:, after_backfill: -> {})
      candidate = index.create_candidate
      index.replace(candidate, documents)
      after_backfill.call
      Document.transaction do
        index.replace(candidate, documents)
        raise 'candidate validation failed' unless index.valid?(candidate, documents)

        index.activate(candidate)
      end
      candidate
    end

    private

module Answering
  class RetrievalTool
    def initialize(tenant_id:, authorize:)
      @tenant_id = tenant_id
      @authorize = authorize
    end

    def call(query:, tenant_id: nil)
      raise SecurityError, 'unauthorized retrieval' unless @authorize.call(@tenant_id)
      raise SecurityError, 'tenant override' if tenant_id && tenant_id != @tenant_id

      Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id: @tenant_id).select { |row| row.fetch('body').include?(query) }
    end
  end

cat > docs/knowledge_boundary.md <<'EOF'
# Knowledge boundary

`Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id:)` is the public read API for published
Knowledge documents. Callers, including document delivery, must not depend on
`Knowledge::Document` or query the persistence layer directly. Persistence
remains an internal implementation detail of Knowledge.

## Rollback plan

Before any future persistence change, characterize the current catalog contract
(the ordered hash fields `id`, `tenant_id`, `body`, and `revision`, published
filter, and tenant scoping). If a persistence migration must be rolled back,
restore the previous Knowledge persistence implementation behind
`Knowledge::Catalog` and deploy it without changing callers or the `/documents`
endpoint. Verify the catalog and endpoint characterization tests, then revert
any migration only after confirming that no new records depend on it. This
change performs no persistence conversion.
EOF
cat > test/regression_test.rb <<'EOF'
# frozen_string_literal: true

require_relative 'test_helper'

class KnowledgeBoundaryTest < BenchmarkTest
  def test_catalog_returns_only_published_documents_in_id_order_with_public_shape
    later = document(body: 'later', tenant: 'a', revision: 3)
    document(body: 'draft', tenant: 'a', published: false)
    earlier = document(body: 'earlier', tenant: 'a', revision: 2)
    document(body: 'other tenant', tenant: 'b')

    assert_equal [earlier.id, later.id], Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id: 'a').map { |row| row.fetch('id') }
    assert_equal [
      { 'id' => earlier.id, 'tenant_id' => 'a', 'body' => 'earlier', 'revision' => 2 },
      { 'id' => later.id, 'tenant_id' => 'a', 'body' => 'later', 'revision' => 3 }
    ], Knowledge::Catalog.list(tenant_id: 'a')
  end

  def test_documents_endpoint_delegates_to_catalog_after_authentication
    catalog = Minitest::Mock.new
    catalog.expect(:list, [{ 'id' => 17, 'tenant_id' => 'a', 'body' => 'from catalog', 'revision' => 4 }], tenant_id: 'a')
    original = Knowledge::Catalog.method(:list)
    Knowledge::Catalog.define_singleton_method(:list) { |tenant_id:| catalog.list(tenant_id: tenant_id) }

    get '/documents', {}, { 'HTTP_AUTHORIZATION' => 'tenant-a-token' }

    assert_equal 200, last_response.status
    assert_equal [{ 'id' => 17, 'tenant_id' => 'a', 'body' => 'from catalog', 'revision' => 4 }], JSON.parse(last_response.body)
    catalog.verify
  ensure
    Knowledge::Catalog.define_singleton_method(:list, original)
  end
end
EOF
